verdict.rationale: Mastra runs its own server that registers agents and workflows and can ship them as standalone endpoints, so core agent and workflow execution is reachable programmatically. Nothing shows that Studio's building, testing and managing functions are mirrored in that API, no OpenAPI spec was found, and one team reported repeatedly writing their own Hono routes. missing for 10: documented API parity with Studio management and testing functions, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, independent confirmation that UI actions are API-accessible.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
or ships them as standalone endpoints
